description: This file contains an abstract test class `BaseModuleActivatorTest` used for unit testing module activation in the OpenMRS project. It provides setup routines and constants relevant for module-related tests, extending `BaseContextSensitiveTest`.

classes.name: BaseModuleActivatorTest
classes.description: An abstract base class for unit tests related to module activation within the OpenMRS system, providing common setup and module initialization logic.

methods.name: beforeEachTest
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test method execution, including initializing module test data and loading specific modules.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes test data for predefined module IDs.
